name: tree-of-life
description: Collaborative hydromorphodynamic terrain simulation with Cloudflare persistence

scripts.build: echo 'No build step needed - static files only'

author: Laurent Perrinet

notes.performance: One CPU physics step per animation frame on a 50,264-vertex polar mesh with 1,500 water parcels; see PERFORMANCE.md for measured costs.
notes.optimization: Typed arrays (Float64Array for the bed, Float32Array for biology) on a single thread; sand relaxation dominates the physics step.
notes.dependencies_external: Three.js r128 is loaded from cdnjs; the browser app needs no npm install. The Worker is deployed with wrangler.
